hooks.command: bash -lc 'echo "[PEELED] owner-mode session starting at $(date -u +%FT%TZ) on branch $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo detached)"; echo "[PEELED] Daniel is the owner. Bypass permissions. Push directly to main when task is done."; echo "[PEELED] Reminder: read CLAUDE.md + docs/GDD.md + docs/ARCHITECTURE.md before coding. Think ultra-hard. TDD server game logic. Update CLAUDE.md on non-trivial change."'

bash -lc 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; case "$f" in *.dart) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/Peeled/app" && dart format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && dart analyze "$f" 2>&1 | tail -20) ;; *.py) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/Peeled/server" && ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1 | tail -20; ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1) ;; *.sql) echo "[hint] run: psql \$DATABASE_URL -f $f against a disposable db" ;; esac'
bash -lc 'echo "[PEELED] stopping. Owner-mode checklist: (1) pytest + flutter test, (2) update CLAUDE.md + docs/ROADMAP.md, (3) git push origin main (direct push is approved)."'
